editor.name: Name
editor.stream.helper: For cameras with several streams (e.g. Reolink). Auto uses the light stream on the card and the best one in the dialog.
editor.ptz_speed.helper: Leave empty to use the camera default speed. Only used if the camera supports it.
card.no_device: Select a camera in the card editor.
card.no_camera: This device has no enabled camera entity.
ptz.missing_stop: Enable the “PTZ stop” entity of this camera, otherwise moves can't be stopped.
ptz.missing_zoom: Enable the “PTZ zoom in/out” entities for smooth optical zoom.
editor.show_ptz.helper: Only shown if the camera supports pan & tilt and its PTZ entities are enabled (including “PTZ stop”).
editor.show_optical_zoom.helper: Only shown if the camera has optical zoom and its zoom entities are enabled.
editor.door_entity.helper: Lock, button or switch that opens the door. Adds a door button to the live view, with confirmation.
